semantic_contract: Default lookback30, SMA30, entry threshold1 and exit threshold0. Current-inclusive30 completed closes are individually logged in chronological order. The estimator regresses29 log increments on their29 lagged log levels using scipy.stats.linregress.

theta=-slope. Only when theta>1e-6 use mu=intercept/theta and equilibrium_std=sigma/sqrt(2*theta). At equality or below, including negative theta, mu is the mean of all30 log prices and equilibrium_std=sigma. Do not add a positive-theta or half-life filter.

Residuals=dx-(intercept+slope*x_lag), sigma=np.std(residuals) with default population ddof0. Current z=(log current close-mu)/equilibrium_std. Use source arithmetic and library defaults rather than textbook OU reparameterization.
Flat long entry is strictly z<-1 AND current close>SMA30. Native short entry is z>1 AND current close<SMA30. These are current states, not threshold crossings.

Held long exit is strictly z>0; held short exit is strictly z<0. The long exit is independent of short-entry price/SMA and threshold1 conditions. A Spot long/cash adapter must retain a distinct long-exit flag instead of reusing the short-entry flag.

Source has no active stop, target, trailing, timeout, max-hold or same-bar reversal. Its branch structure separates flat entry from held exit. Pending orders suppress new signals after feature calculation.

Fewer than10 estimator inputs return None values; default strategy waits until lookback30, with SMA30 framework minimum period. Fit exceptions return None values. None mu/std or std<=0 makes next return before entry or exit, preserving any holding.

Source NaN mu/std is not explicitly rejected: comparisons can remain false and holdings persist. A future positive finite data contract may exclude invalid prices, but unsupported nonfinite fit results need a declared fail-closed/hold policy and synthetic fixtures. No automatic liquidation is a source default.
causality: Completed current/past closes suffice for the rolling fit and SMA. No future resampling is present. Eight-hour signals must be timestamped as available only after the completed bar, with actions at next minute open. dt=1 is one supplied bar; do not silently rescale theta/sigma or optimize thresholds for8h.
